svg.title: The Hum: DM map
svg.text: Year Two, first session. The outflow tunnel under the Weirs (hex C3), as far as the inner door. Players never see this sheet.

g.text: Bold hexes are travelled this session. Times are for a party at 120'. Leave at dawn; the flush is at midnight.
The inner door (shut; the session stops)

svg.text: Hex key lines (from the Fort Country sheet):

g.text: C3 The Weirs · Old fish traps. New stakes.
C4 The Old Road · A humming milestone.
C5 Boar Hollow · A hunter's lodge. A map nailed inside.
D4 The Fort · Home. Biddy guards the henhouse.

svg.text: 1 square = 10 feet · the tube falls gently north-east under the lake

g.text: the inner door: shut. Beyond, the Eval Chamber
(Year Two DM Guide; not keyed here)
D 360 ft (3 / 1). No traps in the reaches.
T1 bell-line (harmless) · T2 dark slab drops the gate
Midnight, one hour: the channel overflows;
T2 fills to 4 ft; the T4 blade runs every turn.
The water comes from under the inner door.
T1 W arch · E reach A
T2 W reach A · E gate, reach B (or the crawl pipe)
T3 S reach B · E reach C
T4 W reach C · N (east end) reach D
T5 S reach D · N the inner door

svg.text: Original map for The Hum. Art rule: Otus ink.
